usefulChanges: The schema command now writes a usable configuration schema.
Public export subpaths, specifier-scoped modules and export collision handling make package layouts more faithful.
JSDoc rendering and declaration-catalog composition have substantially improved.

Stable Xantham.Fable.Core and Xantham.Fable.Core.TS packages provide shared generated support types; the separately published Xantham.Fable.Node package is a later Node-target candidate that still needs its own qualification.
blockers: Xantham 0.1.0 emits `open Fable.Core.TS.Dom` for the qualified ANSI candidate, making Xantham.Fable.Core.TS a compile dependency even though the mapped candidate uses no DOM type.
Xantham.Fable.Core.TS 0.1.0 contains only a net8.0 asset and cannot restore into the template's required netstandard2.1 candidate project (NU1202).
evidence: The exact xantham 0.1.0 package reports source c68c15f1421a43d40a8f0953a8966d0c1d2f46c9, package SHA-512 wwSsJNLfazcf2rcvIB5xTJBox+hOWTPurcM5JJf6MylPvUPS9orriQtbg0UIM9eNqy9eYRn42lVPbjdEusIEjg==, generator assembly SHA-256 93a7da1b00b95ef4c0490bae54ecda9883bba59fc65fbf7e21668b630d70b5eb and retains TypeScript 7.1.0-dev.20260902.1.

The mapped ansi-regex@6.2.2 candidate generated with zero widened or escaped symbols, compiled on net8.0 with Xantham.Fable.Core.TS 0.1.0, Fable-compiled with Fable 5.13.0 and passed the real Node journey.
The same generated source failed netstandard2.1 restore because Xantham.Fable.Core.TS 0.1.0 supports net8.0 only.
qualificationChecks: require a netstandard2.1-compatible Xantham.Fable.Core.TS asset or generated output that omits unused compiler-library opens
prepare and verify exact CLI/compiler/support hashes
repeat ANSI candidate, manifest and symbol bytes
integrationSteps: Keep xantham 0.1.0-alpha.2 as the executable qualified baseline.
Recheck Xantham.Fable.Core.TS when it publishes a netstandard2.1 asset, or recheck generated output when Xantham stops emitting an unused DOM open.
Then update CLI and support pins and fingerprints together and run the full candidate qualification before accepting 0.1.0 or a successor.
